Title: Create a new order with numeric, boolean, and text measurement parameters and verify they are stored and displayed correctly
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and has at least one item configured with numeric, boolean, and text measurement parameters
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' screen. 2. Select an existing customer or create a new one. 3. Select an item that has numeric, boolean, and text measurement parameters (e.g., 'Shirt'). 4. Enter a numeric value for 'Chest Width' (e.g., 42.5). 5. Toggle the boolean value for 'Has Pocket' to 'Yes'. 6. Enter a text value for 'Special Notes' (e.g., 'Extra stitching on collar'). 7. Add the item to the order. 8. Submit the order. 9. Open the order details page for the newly created order.

Test Data: Customer: Name=John Doe, Phone=01712345678; Item: Shirt; Measurements: Chest Width=42.5, Has Pocket=Yes, Special Notes=Extra stitching on collar
Expected Result: 1. The order is created successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order created successfully'. 2. The order details page displays all measurement parameters with their correct values: Chest Width = 42.5, Has Pocket = Yes, Special Notes = Extra stitching on collar.

Title: Update an existing order with new numeric, boolean, and text measurement parameters and verify they are updated correctly
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and has an existing order with at least one item that has measurement parameters
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Orders' list and select an existing order. 2. Click 'Edit Order'. 3. Select an item that has measurement parameters. 4. Update the numeric value for 'Chest Width' (e.g., from 42.5 to 44.0). 5. Toggle the boolean value for 'Has Pocket' to 'No'. 6. Update the text value for 'Special Notes' (e.g., to 'No extra stitching'). 7. Save the changes. 8. Open the order details page for the updated order.

Test Data: Order ID: 1-20240515-0001; Measurements: Chest Width=44.0, Has Pocket=No, Special Notes=No extra stitching
Expected Result: 1. The order is updated successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order updated successfully'. 2. The order details page displays all updated measurement parameters with their correct values: Chest Width = 44.0, Has Pocket = No, Special Notes = No extra stitching.

Title: Verify that text measurement parameters are displayed in order history and customer measurement history
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and has an existing order with text measurement parameters for a customer
Steps:

Select an item that has text measurement parameters (e.g., 'Special Notes'). 4. Navigate to the 'Orders' list and select the same order. 5. Open the order details page and verify the text measurement parameter.

Test Data: Customer: John Doe; Item: Shirt; Measurement: Special Notes=Extra stitching on collar
Expected Result: 1. The 'Measurement History' tab for the customer displays the text measurement parameter: Special Notes = Extra stitching on collar. 2. The order details page displays the same text measurement parameter: Special Notes = Extra stitching on collar.
